balls.text: very full and on middle, Duminy moves around in the crease, sweeps it to midwicket off an inside edge
fuller and on middle, he shuffles across off and paddles it to the man at 45 for a scampered single
right in the blockhole outside off, dug out past the covers
Strong swing of the bat but he holes out to Pollard to long-on. Length outside off, Yuvi shovel-whips it with plenty of bottom-hand........ straight into the hands of Pollard at head height
yorker outside off, he angles his bat and squeezes it to backward point
low full toss on off, he misses the yorker. Duminy gets under it and launches it down the ground
yorker outside off, Duminy can only dig it out past Yuvi towards mid-off
full toss outside off, slugged away to deep midwicket
fuller, Duminy makes room and crunches a drive to sweeper

right in the blockhole at the base of middle and off, Yuvi squeezes out a drive to mid-off. Oops, Malinga was overstepped. Or had he done a  Finn there by knocking the stumps over. Malinga did both there. Free-hit on the way
Malinga nails another yorker, this one is outside off. Yuvi can't dig it out. His smile has faded away. Bhajji applauds
yorker again, squeezed behind square leg off an inside edge
yorker length on the leg stump, he gets an inside edge that rolls in front of the bowler

Mathews gone, caught behind. He walks off. This was banged in short and on the stumps, he targets deep square with a pull after backing away, but messes it up. Has to settle with a toe-end to Parthiv behind the wicket
Mathews make ample room outside off, he gets a back of a length ball outside off, which is punched past the covers
drifting onto the pads, glanced away fine on the leg side. Bumrah, who is rather squarer sprints across, dives across to his right and stops the ball
down the track, MM bangs it short to foil Mathews' pull. Flat-batted back to the bowler
he loses his radar and darts it down leg, wide called
Mathews steps away outside leg, the bowler follows him, Mathews dinks it in front of long-on for a couple
back of a length and outside off, Mathews steps away and late-cuts it between short third and backward point
mighty full and on middle and leg, Mathews lasers a drive down to long-on. Only one, for the ball thudded to the fielder
length on middle, Mathews backs away and drives it nicely between the covers and mid-off. Full marks for placement

bowled'em or bowled himself? The leg stump goes for a wander. Yorker speared by Malinga, Iyer had premeditated a lap-scoop after shuffling miles across off. He failed to AB de Villiers it away, Malinga batters the leg stump. Iyer, though, has put DD on course for a strong total. Amre shakes his head in the dug-out
Duminy shimmies forward, Malinga slings in a very full ball, not a perfect yorker. Off the pad and they sneak a leg bye
he sees Iyer back away, nails a yorker at the base of middle, squirted in front of the covers for a hustled single
hurled very full and around off, he squeezes a drive towards mid-off and sets off. MM fails to effect a direct hit, and concedes an extra run via overthrow
half-tracker outside off, he fetches it from there and pummels a pull over deep midwicket. It was the slower ball but Duminy had manufactured his own pace
b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l from JPD. Lowish full toss on off, he drives it handsomely over extra-cover, skims away to the fence
slower ball, he has a crude slog and drags it to the leg off the inside half of the bat
Bumrah hunts for a yorker, goes too full. Duminy clears his front leg and drills it past the bowler. Long-on (Chand) runs across, slides to his right and prevents the ball from reaching the boundary
back of a length and outside off, slowy ball. Swatted to long-on
slower ball outside off, he waits on it and slices it to the right of Simmons at sweeper cover

on a fuller-length and on the leg stump, whipped away to the cow corner boundary, bisecting the gap between deep midwicket and long-on with surgical precision. MM was running across to his left from long-on
dug in shortish, mis-hit pull in front of long-on

They go up to the TV umpire for a stumping chance. Fractionally back of a length and outside off, Iyer steps away, makes room, swings and does not connect. The back foot was in the air momentarily, keeper's back foot was also in the air. But Iyer had dragged it back by the time the bails were whipped off
fullish and outside off, slower in place. Swing and a miss
half-tracker outside off, he fetches it from there and pulls it to deep midwicket
back of a length and on middle, Iyer backs away and carves it to sweeper cover
this was looped up by Harbhajan, Duminy loads up for a slog sweep. Skies it via a top edge. Long-on runs forward, but the ball lands in front of him. Duminy reaches a fifty of his own
dropped shortish and widish outside off, slapped away to deep point
full toss on middle from round the stumps, punched back at the bowler, who gets it right hand to it and deflects it down the ground
andd again! Slower and outside off, Iyer sinks to one knee, pasting a slog-sweep into the stands over deep midwicket
length on middle, right in the hitting zone and Iyer has tonked it. Dispatched over the long-on boundary. Pravin Amre seemed to have enjoyed that hit
slid through on middle, Duminy wants to chop it through the off side, gets an inside edge to Malinga at 45
dragged short and outside off, Iyer has a crack at it, gets a thick outside edge, this one flies over vacant slip cordon. Well, well, edges get you boundaries in T20s
keeps it short and homing in on the ribs. Iyer does not flinch. He attempts a hook, gets a top-edge that flies over Malinga at long leg
dug in shortish and outside off, another swing and a misses. He was cramped for room. MM went up for a caught-behind appeal. But there was no nick on that
shortish and outside off, this ball has some good extra lift as well. Iyer flashes and misses
Duminy nips down the track, the bowler drags his length back on the leg stump. Pulled away towards deep midwicket
back of a length with some extra lift outside off, the ball bounces over the attempted late cut
picked away off the hips wide of the man diving to his right at short fine. Duminy semi-paddled, semi-whipped it away
another bad ball. Pollard has lost the plot. Full toss outside at 124ks, Duminy annihilates a six over deep midwicket. DD shifting gears
length on the leg stump, that's easy pickings. Duminy picks it up and lifts it high and over backward square leg
Pollard goes wide of the crease and fires it on off, drilled down to long-on
slower full one outside off, jammed out past the covers for one
poor ball and put away. Full toss outside off, he takes it from there and slaps it over the bowler's head. Long on can't run across in time and cut it off
length and slanted across off, past the tram-line and wide called
Iyer backs away outside off, Bumrah delivers it on a back of a length and wide outside off. Iyer reaches out and chops it to point
oh boy! he has squeezed out a yorker for a four. Right in the blockhole on off, he angles his bat and squeezes it through vacant slip for a fifty
Iyer backs away, Bumrah delivers a full-toss, which is slapped away past the covers
clean strike. Length-ball, he comes forward a bit and sends it sailing over Pollard. Deposited into the sightscreen
tickled off the pads towards short fine. Simmons in action again as he dives across, goes with two hands and stops the ball. Bumrah applauds
good length angling in on off, he has an almighty slog at it and gets an inside edge onto the thigh. Dribbles to the leg side
Pollard slips in a slower length ball outside off, Iyer spots it and swipes it to the left of deep midwicket. Simmons runs across and limits it to one
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped away to deep square leg
change of pace on middle and leg, tucked away to deep midwicket
dug in short and wide outside off, Iyer wants to lash it away. Flat-bats it to the covers
slower ball outside off at 107.2ks, chopped to the left of short third man
starts off with a length-ball on off, Iyer heaves it over midwicket. Simmons has it covered in the deep
Harbhajan drags it short and wide outside off, Iyer cuts it away to the left of Simmons at sweeper cover off the back foot
quicker on off, down the track and pushed back to the bowler
Duminy drives this length-ball outside off to long-off
full and wide outside off, Iyer throws his bat at it and slices it to sweeper cover
flighted on off, he looks to drive over the covers, gets a thickish edge over midwicket
Duminy comes down the track, does not get close to the pitch of the ball and takes it on the pad
drifting onto the leg stump is Pandya, turned in front of midwicket
back of a length and on middle and leg, nudged in front of midwicket for a speedy single. Rohit fumbles and helps DD's cause
back of a length and hurries on off, pushed to the off side
shortish, width on offer here. Shreyas latches onto it as he cuts it firmly to the left of backward point, beats third man as well
shortish and outside off, he looks to pull, hit high on the bat. Flat-batted back to the bowler
back of a length and outside off at 131.4ks, Duminy waits on it before steering it neatly to third man
offbreak on a length, the line is on off, knocked back to Harbhajan
flatter and on middle and leg, whipped down to long-on
looks like a doosra on the leg stump, clipped away behind square on the leg side
fullish and slower through the air outside off, he stretches forward and laces it to the off-side sweeper
looped up offbreak, Duminy can't chop it away, manages an inside edge onto the pad
flighted on off, pushed past the covers to long-off
veering full on the leg stump, Duminy can't glance it away as he is rapped on the front pad. But this was definitely snaking down leg
fullish and outside off, Duminy loads up for a drive, has to settle with an inside edge that wanders to the left of Malinga
good length on middle at 120.1ks, slower in pace. He taps it in front of midwicket and hares across for a speedy single. The fielder fails to effect a direct hit. Iyer nearly collided with Malinga
low full toss on off as he does not get the yorker right. Sliced to the left of Harbhajan
pitched up and outside off, Iyer plays a charming drive but finds Harbhajan at the covers
slings in a yorker on middle, Duminy jabs his bat down and digs it to the off side and runs across to the other end
veering onto the pads, Duminy works a single wide of midwicket
slid through much quicker on middle and leg, jabbed defensively to mid-on
fuller and quicker outside off, Iyer aims to drive, manages an outside edge that runs away through vacant slip
flatter on middle and leg, down the track and whippily driven to the left of mid-on
on a good length, he knocks it to the right of the bowler
Iyer aims to flick this to leg, gets a leading edge that pops in front of short third man
fullish and attacking the off stump, Duminy presses forward, drives and finds mid-off
fuller and on middle, driven to mid-on
dug in short at a gentle pace, Duminy rocks back and swivel-pulls it, clears backward square leg again
Banged in shortish and down leg with a 'hit me' label on it. JPD picked it up and flicked it over the backward square leg boundary
good length with some away movement, poked to the covers
drifting onto the pads, nudged in front of midwicket. The fielder overruns and fumbles, gifting an easy single
on a length and outside off, Iyer swings his bat at it, slicing it to Pollard at point
MM bangs it short and wide outside off, he uses the pace on it and carves it over backward point for a flat, powerful six
slower length-ball on middle, Iyer picks the offcutter. He waits for it, clears his front leg and launches it over wide mid-on
bouncer angled across, Iyer watches the ball closely before dropping his wrists and swaying away
change of pace and very full on off, jammed back to the bowler
banged in shortish and hurries onto Iyer, who aims for a pull. Hit high on the bat, mishit to mid-on
good length ball on middle at 130.7ks, stops on JPD, who checks his push and chips it in front of mid-on, who was diving forward
fuller and on middle, he shuffles across and flicks it sweetly through square leg
aha, this is a bumper outside off at 133ks. Flies through to the keeper, Iyer does not want any of it. Wided for height
slowy full ball at 116ks, he waits on it and chips it in front of mid-on
pitched up and outside off, forward and driven to mid-off
stray slower ball, Malinga slings it down leg
overpitched on off, he takes it from there, whips his wrists and sends it between midwicket and mid-on
good length and swinging away around off, he yanks his bottom hand off the bat and knocks it to the off side
back of a length and angled in on a fourth-stump line, left alone
this one is sprayed outside off, another wide
MM bangs a bouncer down leg, wide called
back of a length and jags back in, JPD misses the defensive push and is hit high on the thigh. He did not account for the movement there
an appeal for caught behind straightaway. Back of a length and drifting down leg, JPD aims to glance it away, but does not connect, brushes the thigh on its way to the keeper

MM strikes with his third ball! The umpire's check for a possible no-ball, MM is okay. This was shortish, tucking Agarwal up for room. He aims to pull, does so half-heartedly, spoons a simple catch to short midwicket. Rayudu nearly made a mess of it but recovered and pouched it on the second attempt.
fractionally back of a length and sliding across off, he throws his bat at it and slices it to third man
dug in shortish and hurries on top of off, bunted n front of the covers for a speedy single. A direct hit could have put Agarwal in trouble

Daredevils break their nine-match winless streak at home. They end the Kotla drought. Tahir is relieved. Duminy looks pleased. Looks like this was slowy in pace outside off, Malinga hacks and does not connect
slower one outside off, Malinga throws his bat at it and misses

Add another super catch to the list! The sub fielder in action now. Mathews digs it in very short. Harbhajan aims for a pull. Hit high up on the sticker of the bat. Jayant Yadav rushes in from deep midwicket, dives forward and takes it
fuller and wide outside off, not the perfect yorker. Harbhajan can't lay bat on it
right in the blockhole on middle, jammed out to long-on
shortish and on middle, Malinga was tucked up for room. He took his eyes off the ball. Yet he manages to pull it over a leaping midwicket
a wrong'un to finish off a superb spell. Bhajji did not read it, sunk to one knee for a slog-sweep, failed to connect and took it on his pad
dragged to the leg side off the inside half of the bat
fuller and wide outside off, swing and a miss. Another wide
darted quicker and outside leg as Malinga skips out and misses. Bounces off the footmarks and hits Jadhav on the bicep
flatter lebgreak from Tahir, Malinga swings and misses
low full toss, slogged away to the leg side
sprayed wide outside off, spins away further. Bhajji can't reach out and connect. Wide
slid through on off, pushed back to the bowler from the crease
Coulter-Nile pulls all the pace of this short ball outside off and slices it to sweeper cover
Bhajji makes room outside leg again, the bowler follows him with a yorker, off the front thigh to the off side
Bhajji has smoked the pants off it. I'm afraid its too late, though. Banged in short on middle, Bhaji sits back, waits on it and swings it over deep midwicket
Malinga makes room, Coulter-Nile takes his eyes off the ball as he attempts a pull. Off the body and loops over the keeper
slower outside off at 110ks, carved away to sweeper cover
bumpy short ball outside off, Bhajji slogs and only meets with thin air
tossed up googly, Malinga goes for an almighty swipe but only manages to connect with thin air
slid through on the fourth-stump line, Malinga is crease-bound as he pushes it back to the bowler to avert the hat-trick

And he is out! Tahir is off on a celebratory run, you can't stop him! He is on a hat-trick. This was fuller and flatter on middle, McClenaghan attempts a reverse sweep first ball, gets an under-edge, loops off the pad, rebounds off the back of the bat to the left of Jadhav
Another one for Coulter-Nile, another one for Tahir! Rayudu walks back for 30. This was flighted and full outside off, Rayudu aims to loft it, ends up slicing it into the hands of long-off
fuller and spinning away outside off, he throws his bat at it and slices it over point

Coulter-Nile takes it at long-off. Pandya out for a golden duck. He gives this air on off, the new man looks for the lofted hit. Does not get enough power behind it. Coulter-Nile rushes forward and completes a fine, tumbling catch

Delhi have their man now.. This was dug in short and on the body, Rohit wants to pull it away. But loses all his balance as his bottom hand comes off the bat handle. He has to settle with a top-edge. The man from deep square leg and deep midwicket nearly collided. Nadeem somehow plucks it out
good length ball on the leg stump, Rohit steps away lofts it high in the air. Duminy back-pedals, but Rohit just about clears him at long-off
dug in shortish and change of pace outside off, he seeks to pull. Toe-ends it towards covers
fullish and curls back in close to off, slices Rayudu into half as he is beaten emphatically on the inside edge. Rayudu was crease-bound as he pushes at it
dug in on a back of a length and on middle, Rayudu executes a pull over a leaping midwicket for back-to-back fours
back of a length and outside off, he steps away and has enough leverage to thrash it through point. Sweeper can't cut that off
Rayudu skips out, Tahir shortens his length and drifts it down leg. Rayudu chips it, the ball rolls to the leg side
darted flatter and on middle and leg, clipped to long on. The fielder rushes in, aims to attack the ball and does not collect it cleanly in the end. The pair get two
quick on off, chopped to point. Rayudu wants a single but is sent back
tossed up, he misses the defensive push and is truck on the front pad
full and on middle and leg, driven to long-on again
mighty full and on middle, eased down to long-on
darted quicker and straighter, helped down to long-on for one
excellent connection. Rayudu gets into the act. He nips down the track, gets close to the pitch of this length-ball and swings it over deep midwicket
fuller on off, down the track and smashed to long-off
shortish and outside off, punched to the covers
Rohit steps out, manufactures a length ball and lofts it straight over the bowler's head
full and outside off, driven to long-off
quicker and outside off, cracked to extra cover
loobed up outside off, Rohit sees ample air, gets under it and smears it over to the long-off boundary
length on off, slogged away to cow corner

lobbed up outside off, he chips down the track gets beaten in flight. Off the pad and dribbles to right of the keeper.   Rayudu lost track of the ball. Jadhav aims to flick it back but makes a mess of it, fluffs a stumping
down the track and whipped away over a leaping midwicket
flatter and outside off, he looks to sweep, drags it to midwicket
tucked away off the pads towards deep midwicket. Deep square runs to his left to mop it up
flatter and darted on middle and leg, down the track and picked away to long-on
fuller on off, down the track and pushed back to Nadeem
quicker on off as Rayudu looks to advance down the track. Chopped to the off side
arm-ball on middle, Rohit stays back and punches it to long-off
flatter and outside off, driven past the dive of short cover to long-off
down the track, the bowler drags his length back, punched back to the bowler
fullish, drifts in to rap Rohit on the pad. Not sure if that was the googly
nudged through vacant mid-on
fuller and driven past the covers
Pollard perishes and this is a crucial strike for DD.. This was flatter and spinning away outside off, Pollard rocks back and slices it high in the air. Nadeem juggles and pouches it at deep cover
fuller and straighter, clipped away towards cow corner
fired on off and middle, pushed back to Tahir
whack! Looked like the wrong'un. Pollard flexes his muscles and wallops it  over deep midwicket
legbreak from Tahir, pushed to the off-side sweeper
skiddy back of a length ball on middle and leg, tucks Pollard up for room. Punched to long-on off the back foot
flatter and darted on off, Pollard inches forward to defend it in front of the covers
full -toss and he gets away. Rohit pushes it down to long-on for only one
tucked away behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs
googly from Mishra, Pollard is rapped in font of middle and leg. Pollard did not offer a shot, but this was sliding down leg and the lbw cry amounts to nothing
pitched up and on off, driven past the covers

Mishra strikes, he roars! Much slower through the air, looped up outside off, lures the batsman out of the crease. Chand misses his attempted big hit over the leg side. The ball kept low as well but Jadhav breaks the bails in a flash
googly spins in on off, he waits on it and dabs it through the vacant slip cordon. Neatly done, Yuvi runs back, slides but the ball winds the race
fuller and on middle, defended back to the bowler
punched down to long-on
flat darter down leg, Chand still can't help it away. Another wide
drifting down leg, Chand can't tickle it away. Wide called
arm-ball arrows in with the angle on middle, defended back to the bowler
slower and fuller on off, dropped in front of the covers for an urgent single
quicker and outside off, he comes halfway forward and [pushes to the covers
too full and straight/ shading onto the leg stump, tucked behind square on the leg side
lobbed up and spinning across off, sharp turn, stops in the pitch as well. Mistimed cut towards long-off
shortish, Rohit stands tall and still as he punches it to long-off
googly down leg, off the keeper's pad and it rolls away in front of square leg
spinning down leg, Chand loses his balance and falls over the sweep. No tickle on that. Umpire disagrees with me
back of a length on middle, punched to long-on
fuller and on middle and leg, he plays a wristy drive to long-off
tossed up on middle, driven past the bowler to mid-off

Tahir pulls off a sharp catch and sets off on a victory lap. He is mobbed by his team-mates. This was a slower one dug in short and on middle, Parthiv got a good chunk of wood on the pull. Hits it in the air over midwicket. Tahir covers some ground from deep square leg, dives across to his right and comes out with the ball in his hands
fractionally back of a length and outside off, slash and miss
Parthiv has middled this. Length and just outside off, he clobbers it straight down the ground. Picked the slower one and dispatched it
good length ball on middle, drilled over a leaping Mathews, beats mid-on diving to his right. Parthiv backed away and did not middle it. Yet he collected a four
slowy ball outside off, Parthiv skips out, swings and does not connect
length outside off, he nips down the track and flat-bats it to the covers
fuller and on middle and off, defended to the left of the bowler
length on middle, blocked back
shortish and on middle, pulled to deep backward square with one feet lifted in the air
length outside off, pushed defensively to point

Cramp or no cramps, Duminy pulls off a brilliant catch! Length on middle, he backs away a touch and mishits it high in the air. The DD captain pedals back from mid-on, then moves to his right, turns back, traces the ball. Dives across to his right, catches and tumbles onto the ground. It's never easy taking these skiers. He initially misjudged it but recovered well
good length, straight in line, blocked to the left of the bowler
nice, juicy full toss, instead of hammering it away. Simmons pushes it limply to mid-off
fuller and outside off, Simmons bends his knee and drives it past the covers
flatter and outside off, whipped away to deep midwicket
pushed through, he sinks to one knee and misses the sweep. Outside the line of off
slid through short and wide outside off, he switches his balance onto the back foot and cuts it fiercely in the gap at the covers
pushed through outside off, Parthiv steps away and scythes it over the covers. Once he cleared the infield that was a four
shortish and hurries on off, Simmons hops up and fends it to the covers
dragged shortish and on middle, he clears his front leg and clubs it away to the deep-midwicket boundary
banged in short and boings outside off, angled in. He has the propensity to generate extra bounce. Simmons backs away a touch, spars at it and is beaten soundly
he goes wide of the crease and angles it outside off, flash and a miss from Simmons
the ball thudded away! Fractionally back of a length, Simmons backs away and unleashes a strong cut past backward point
good length on the fourth-stump line, poked out in front of point
Coulter-Nile strays down leg, back-to-back wides
Simmons make room outside off, Coulter-Nile is wary of it as he bangs a bouncer. Wide called.
back of a length and outside off, he opens his bat face and glides it to the left of backward point. Diving save

length ball on off, he takes a step forward and hacks it wide of mid-on off the inside half of the bat. Duminy gives the chase, dives across to his left and swats the ball in before going over the ad boards. Joseph applauds that effort. Duminy may have jarred his knee there, but looks okay
back of a length and outside off, steered past short point to backward point
good length ball on middle, Parthiv pushes, manages an inside edge onto the pad. The ball rolls back to Joseph
Parthiv charges down the track, the bowler drags his length back. Parthiv slogs and fails to connect
back of a length and skiddy on off, another dab behind square on the off side. No run, here
back of a length and outside off, Parthiv employs finesse now as he dabs it to the right of backward point, to deep third man
veering down leg, Jadhav dives across and collects the ball
on a length and outside off, he punchily drives it, beats the man diving to his left at mid-on. Not much feet movement but enough power on that
back of a length and seams in, skids off the deck. Parthiv is cramped for room but pushes it defensively down the track
extra lift on this short one outside off, Simmons hops up and tames it to the left of second slip. He opens his account
shortish away-going ball outside off, Simmons gets on top of the bounce and taps it to point
ripper first up! Good length ball on off and curves away viciously, Simmons pokes and gets beaten
